integrity.proof_limitations: Analytic infinite-limit argument is supplied; finite computation is supporting evidence only.

scientific_limitations: Restricted to uniform endofunctions with independent uniformly sampled images.
The finite joint distribution and conditional uniform-permutation law are classical ingredients and are not asserted independently original.
No second-order asymptotic remainder or multivariate cycle-vector approximation is established.
An equivalent historical dependence-rate calculation could exist in earlier mapping or permutation approximation literature.
title: Sharp \(n^{-1}\) total-variation dependence of fixed and cyclic points in uniform random mappings
